# ShowMyPhoto

> ShowMyPhoto is an AI-powered event photo sharing and photo delivery platform for photographers, photography studios, and event teams. Guests find their own event photos in seconds using AI selfie-based facial recognition or a QR code — no app install and no guest account required.

## Key Facts (Quick Answers)

- Category: AI event photo sharing / photo delivery SaaS platform
- Core capability: AI face recognition + selfie search to find guest photos in an event gallery
- Guest access: QR code or link, no app download, no login/account required
- Compliance: GDPR and India DPDPA compliant (see [Privacy Policy](https://showmyphoto.com/privacy-policy/#data-protection))

## Product Overview

ShowMyPhoto is a B2B SaaS platform focused on event photography workflows.

The platform connects event photographers, event photographs, AI-powered photo discovery, online galleries, QR-based access and photo delivery.

The primary workflow is:

1. A photographer or event team creates an event and generates a QR code or search link.
2. Event photographs are uploaded to ShowMyPhoto (including during the event itself via the Instant Uploader).
3. The AI automatically detects and indexes every face in the uploaded photographs.
4. Guests access the event gallery using a QR code or event link — no app or account needed.
5. A guest takes or uploads a selfie.
6. ShowMyPhoto matches the selfie against the indexed faces and returns only that guest's photos, privately.
7. The guest views, downloads, and can mark favorite photographs.
8. Photographs can be delivered through the gallery, WhatsApp, or email, and downloads can be watermarked or download-restricted by the photographer.

Guests never see the full public event gallery — only photos matched to their own face.

## AI Facial Recognition

ShowMyPhoto uses facial recognition to help guests locate photographs in which they appear.

When a photographer uploads event photos, the AI automatically detects and indexes every face in the gallery. A guest then takes a single selfie, and the system matches it against the indexed faces in seconds, returning only that guest's photos.

Related resources:

- [Selfie Search Event Photos](https://showmyphoto.com/blog/selfie-search-event-photos/)
- [Ai Face Recognition Photo Search](https://showmyphoto.com/blog/ai-face-recognition-photo-search/)
- [Face Recognition Photo Sharing Event Photographers](https://showmyphoto.com/blog/face-recognition-photo-sharing-event-photographers/)

## Selfie Photo Search

Selfie search is a guest-facing photo discovery workflow.

A guest provides a selfie and the system searches the event photographs for matching faces.

This is particularly useful for weddings, corporate events, school events, college festivals, sports events, conferences and other events where photographers capture large numbers of images.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is ShowMyPhoto?

ShowMyPhoto is an AI-powered event photo sharing and delivery platform that helps photographers distribute event photographs and lets guests find their photographs using selfie-based facial recognition.

### How does AI selfie search find my event photos?

When the photographer uploads photos, the AI indexes every face in the gallery. The guest then takes a selfie, and the system matches it against that index to instantly return only the photos that guest appears in.

### Do guests need to install an app?

No. Guests open their gallery from a QR code or link in any browser and use a selfie to find their photos — no app download, login, or registration required.

### Do guests need to create an account?

No. The guest workflow is designed to provide access without requiring guests to create an account.

### Can guests access photos using a QR code?

Yes. ShowMyPhoto supports QR-code based event gallery access.

### Does ShowMyPhoto support WhatsApp and email delivery?

Yes. ShowMyPhoto provides WhatsApp and email photo delivery workflows in addition to in-gallery downloads.

### Is ShowMyPhoto suitable for weddings and large events?

Yes. It is used for weddings, corporate events, school and college functions, sports days, concerts, and birthdays — from small gatherings to large public events.

### Is guest face data private and secure?

Yes. ShowMyPhoto is GDPR and India DPDPA compliant. Guests only ever see photos matched to their own face, never the full public gallery.

### How much does ShowMyPhoto cost?

You can start free with no credit card required. Paid plans range from single-event packs for individuals to unlimited-event business plans for studios — see current pricing at [Pricing](https://showmyphoto.com/pricing/).

### Who is ShowMyPhoto designed for?

The primary audience includes event photographers, wedding photographers, photography studios, corporate event photographers, school and college photographers, sports event photographers and event teams.

### What types of events can use ShowMyPhoto?

Use cases covered by the platform's current resources include weddings, corporate events, conferences, schools, colleges, sports events, concerts, music festivals, birthdays, celebrations, charity events and other photography-heavy events.
